auditCommand: for each discovered project.yml: vaporize inspect-project-yml --path <path> --format text
boundary: This receipt proves read compatibility for discovered legacy XcodeGen project.yml files. It does not prove that every project builds, installs, launches, has a valid checked-in pbxproj, or is ready for Pkl-backed generation.
releaseImpact: The Swift YAML read bridge appears broad enough for fleet intake. Vaporize v0.0.1 remains blocked on Pkl-backed project generation and classified XcodeGen quarantine.
